Class Anthozoa > Subclass Zoantharia/Hexacorallia > Order Scleractinia Family Merulinidae Elephant-nose plate coral Mycedium elephantotus*
Family Merulinidaeupdated Nov 2019

Where seen? This hard coral forms a thick plate with large bumps. It is rarely encountered on the intertidal.

Features: Colonies 20-30cm. Encrusting plate, thick. Large cup-shaped corallites (about 1.5cm) that look like a nose. Polyp tentacles are only extended at night. Terumbu Bemban, Apr 16


Terumbu Bemban, Jun 19

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
